# Introduction {description="Why the study was run and what it set out to show."}

The study followed a cohort of patients for 24 weeks.

## Background

Earlier studies measured the outcome at one time point only.

## Objectives

The study measures the outcome at four time points.

# Study design {description="How the study was set up and who took part."}

The study enrolled patients from three centres.

## Population

Adults with a confirmed diagnosis could take part.

## Analysis

A mixed model compares the arms at each time point.
